en: Illustrated postcard showing two young women in richly decorated traditional folk costumes standing by a riverbank. One woman carries a wooden yoke with a dark water jug hanging from it, while the other holds a small book or box. Both wear embroidered blouses, full patterned skirts, necklaces, earrings, and large red ribbons in their hair. In the misty background are calm waters, low trees, and a distant vertical structure such as a church tower. At the lower left appears an artist's signature reading something like "Pecsi Pich D 93".
